objective: The next step of COLLAR-PLANE-20261108-001 (G1, space from a law; A25), started on 2026-11-08 at the coordinator's go-ahead: no undecorated local law of the pinwheel forces roundness, so how much hidden information does? Hidden labels that are local functions of the tiling add nothing (the cut crystals still pass), so the information must be non-local. Measure it with decorated substitutions: each tile carries a label from a small alphabet, Conway's cut gives each child a label fixed by its parent's label and its child index, and the law is the set of labelled collars of the labelled pinwheel tilings. Start with one bit per tile (all 1,024 decorated substitutions on two labels): which of them exclude the cut rhombus crystal of COLLAR-PLANE-20261108-001A at which levels, then follow any survivor to other crystals and to forced composition. Standalone value against known work: decorated matching rules force the pinwheel (Radin 1994) and every substitution tiling (Mozes 1989; Goodman-Strauss 1998), with alphabets far larger than one bit; the least decoration that forces the pinwheel, or excludes its crystals, was not found.
status: Complete 2026-11-08: roundness in the plane costs hidden information that no bounded window of the tiling determines (labels read from a window never force the pinwheel: the cut rhombus crystal obeys their law at every radius), and for decorated substitutions the rule radius does not matter. One hidden bit per tile, placed by a decorated substitution, fails in 1,008 of the 1,024 cases (a periodic labelling of the cut rhombus, brick or period-4 brick crystal obeys the law); in the other 16, eight up to relabelling, the bit already forces every parent's label, and pairwise consistency leaves labelled parent collars outside the law, so whether one of them forces the pinwheel is open. Recommendation: Continue with settling the sixteen, Payoff 2/3 Substantial, Concreteness 2/3 Testable, awaiting the coordinator's go-ahead.
stop_rule: Stop when the one-bit decorated substitutions are classified against the rhombus crystal to a declared level, and any survivor is either shown to admit a crystal or followed to a forcing argument; or when an obstruction to one bit is found.
title: The price of roundness in the plane
